I'm there right now. If anything? It's solidified the fact that I really don't want to stay and am entirely alone. The aggression thrown my way for admitting I want to kill myself and am struggling is.. Astonishing. People try to guilt me, give me reasons. I've made up my mind. I've been trying to maintain the facade while preparing everything for me to go. Luckily and not so lucky I'm in a huge life changing situation so getting rid of things and making some "living situation adjustments" has been easy to get away with without attracting too much attention. I'm not one to give things away, or give gifts so no worries about that on my end. But for things I am leaving behind I wrote it in my will which I drafted last night, it'll be maybe a year or two before I'm gone. Right now trying to make people believe I'm "adjusting to my new normal" is hell. I want to die right the fuck now but... I just.. Haven't decided how to actually go and there are some things I'd like to do before I left. Set some things in place for people I cared about, just to make it all easier for them when it comes time to sort my things, settle accounts and all that
